sloka: बुद्धिरूपं फलं पुत्राञ्छौर्यं धीरत्वमेव च ।प्राप्नुवन्ति नरा लोके निर्जितं पुण्यकर्मभिः ।। ७.१५.२६ ॥
transliteration: buddhirūpaṁ phalaṁ putrāñchauryaṁ dhīratvameva ca ।prāpnuvanti narā loke nirjitaṁ puṇyakarmabhiḥ ।। 7.15.26 ॥

translations.english: Men in this world obtain intellect, beauty, prosperity, sons, valor, and steadfastness, all of which are acquired through meritorious deeds.
